observations: Washington LT Laremy Tunsil suffered a torn triceps during practice on 2026-08-08 and requires surgery.
The team confirmed an extended absence but has not published a full-season timetable.
Washington's stated replacement plan: Brandon Coleman to LT, Chris Paul at LG, Josh Conerly Jr. remaining at RT, Andrew Wylie as swing-tackle depth.
inferences: Pressure, sack, hit, and throwaway rates could rise if the replacement does not hold (H3), pressuring passing efficiency.
Scramble and designed-movement volume could rise, which cuts against passing efficiency loss for fantasy purposes.
Quick game, under-center play action, and rollouts could preserve quarterback conditions (H2).
